source: SIX Interbank Clearing, Swiss Implementation Guidelines for the QR-bill, Version 2.4 (24.02.2026, valid from 14 November 2026): https://www.six-group.com/dam/download/banking-services/standardization/qr-bill/ig-qr-bill-v2.4-en.pdf
notes: Expected payloads come from Table 8 and the Annex A examples (German original values, without the English translation glosses), not from this library.

Lines are compared after dropping trailing empty status-A lines (StrdBkgInf, AltPmt): 4.1.4 says they are omitted when unused, while the Annex A tables show them as empty lines. Both forms are accepted.
known_gap names a finding in tests/data/six/COMPLIANCE.md. Such vectors are expected to fail today; the runner fails once one passes, so the marker gets removed together with the fix.
